parameters: Jetland: Hey, thanks for getting me out of
there and being with me on the way out.
I gotta go report back to the King.
Here's a key to my old skiff, a trusty little
boat parked outside Unfrey you're welcome to
take.  For me, it served it's purpose.
Though you never made mushroom-picking a hobby of yours, you
reach toward the cluster and pluck out a vivid and brightly
colored mushroom, then pocket it.  It smells really sweet,
but your fingers are now burning a bit from touching it.
You unlock the door with the jail key.
